title: Whoop Strain-to-Recovery Mismatch Days
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whoop:day
| search strain_minus_recovery=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(strain_minus_recovery) as avg_strain_minus_recovery max(strain_minus_recovery) as max_strain_minus_recovery by _time training_block
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Whoop strain-to-recovery mismatch over time and breaks it out by training block.
value: Mismatch days show when you are training as if recovered even though the physiology data says otherwise.
implementation: Send Whoop strain-to-recovery mismatch events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Whoop strain-to-recovery mismatch by training block.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how Whoop strain-to-recovery mismatch changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
